author: BenjaminRS
body:
This PR updates the TQ BDT to [v1.0.0](https://gitlab.cern.ch/cms-tracker-phase2-data-processing/BE_firmware/track-finder/l1-track-finding-track-quality/-/tags/v1.0.0). It was created using the [TQ CI pipeline #14896541](https://gitlab.cern.ch/cms-tracker-phase2-data-processing/BE_firmware/track-finder/l1-track-finding-track-quality/-/pipelines/14896541).
Slides are attached detailing this new model and the validation performed on L1T objects.
[TQInvestigation_BRS_260130.pdf](https://github.com/user-attachments/files/33064755/TQInvestigation_BRS_260130.pdf)
title: Updating the TQBDT to v1.0.0 (May2026 training)
